findings.title: Reflected XSS via unescaped request.referer in postMessage targetOrigin
findings.body: app/views/layouts/embed.html.erb line 11 interpolates '<%= request.referer %>' directly into a JavaScript string. Referer is attacker-controlled request input and is only HTML-escaped, not JS-string escaped. A referer containing ', </script>, or backslashes breaks out of the string/script context and executes arbitrary JS in the embed origin. It is also functionally wrong because postMessage targetOrigin must be an origin, not a full URL with path.

findings.title: Stored XSS via raw_html cook bypass for imported feed content
findings.body: app/models/post.rb line 133 returns raw unconditionally when cook_method is raw_html, skipping PrettyText cooking/sanitization and Plugin::Filter. app/models/topic_embed.rb imports untrusted RSS/Atom/Readability HTML and stores it as raw_html, then app/views/embed/best.html.erb renders it with `raw post.cooked`. Remote <script>, <iframe>, on* handlers and similar survive end-to-end and execute for forum visitors in both embed and normal topic views.

findings.title: SSRF and unhandled fetch in import_remote via open()
findings.body: app/models/topic_embed.rb line 48 does open(url).read on an embed_url / feed link with no allowlist beyond a /^https?/ regex, no timeout, size limit, redirect limit, or error handling. Combined with lib/topic_retriever.rb fetch_http and app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb, an attacker-influenced URL can force the server to fetch internal hosts, hang the job, raise and retry, or read large payloads. open-uri can also have surprising behaviors on unexpected schemes/redirects.

findings.title: Unescaped URL interpolation and caller-string mutation in import
findings.body: app/models/topic_embed.rb line 13 appends "#{url}" with raw url from RSS/remote input into stored raw_html. A URL containing a single quote or HTML breaks the attribute and injects markup/JS that is later rendered raw. The same line mutates the caller's contents string with <<, surprising callers that reuse the string.

findings.title: Non-atomic throttle with unbounded Redis key
findings.body: lib/topic_retriever.rb lines 25-28 use $redis.setnx then a separate $redis.expire for key "retrieved:#{@embed_url}". If the process crashes between calls the key never expires and throttles that URL forever. The key embeds the full attacker-influenced URL unhashed, so varying paths/queries create unbounded distinct 60s keys and allow Redis memory exhaustion even though the host is constrained.

findings.title: PollFeed crashes on feed items without content
findings.body: app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb line 35 calls i.content.scrub unconditionally. SimpleRSS items commonly have nil content (title/link only) or nil link/title, causing NoMethodError that aborts the whole hourly poll so no items are imported. The feed_key method for conditional polling is also defined but never used, so every run refetches and re-revises.

findings.title: Embed controller spec does not match implementation
findings.body: spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb lines 40-45 expect EmbedController to instantiate TopicRetriever directly, but app/controllers/embed_controller.rb enqueues Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic,...). The spec therefore cannot pass against the shipped code and leaves the actual async path, loading render, and user_id passing untested.
